query:
Two people observe that Adaeze saying 'it's fine' about the Christmas fund has become a recurring pattern and that the issue deserves to be put on the agenda properly. Which of the following made this specific observation — and what in how they expressed it distinguishes their message from the other person who said something similar immediately before?

Options:
A. Obiageli
B. Chisom
C. Nkechi
D. Ifeoma
context:
[1] (about=Adaeze, core, t10 @2025-11-23T18:12:00) Adaeze asks for someone to co-manage the Christmas fund with her from this December; she nearly dropped it in November after six years alone.
[2] (about=Adaeze, said_by=Ifeoma, profile, t2 @2025-10-26T15:19:00) Ifeoma notes that Adaeze's 'fine for now' answer has been the same for a couple of years.
[3] (about=Adaeze, said_by=Obiageli, profile, t10 @2025-11-23T18:12:00) Obiageli thanks Adaeze for speaking clearly; she has been waiting two years for Adaeze to stop saying it's fine.
[4] (about=Adaeze, said_by=Chisom, profile, t2 @2025-10-26T15:19:00) Chisom observes that Adaeze often says it's fine but it's not fully fine.
[5] (about=Adaeze, core, t2 @2025-10-26T15:19:00) Adaeze is willing to handle the fund collection for now but open to revisiting the setup later.
[6] (about=Adaeze, core, t5 @2025-11-09T19:03:00, [earlier-state]) Adaeze tracks fund contributions: Emeka and Obiageli have paid; waiting on Tobenna, Kingsley, Chisom, Ifeoma.
[7] (about=Adaeze, core, t6 @2025-11-09T19:07:00) Adaeze tracks fund contributions: Emeka, Obiageli, Chisom, and Ifeoma have paid; waiting on Tobenna and Kingsley (Kingsley to pay in two parts).
[8] (about=GROUP, said_by=Adaeze, group-interaction, t2 @2025-10-26T15:19:00) Fund contributions to be transferred before 1st December; Adaeze will chase.
[9] (about=GROUP, said_by=Adaeze, group-interaction, t10 @2025-11-23T18:12:00) Adaeze asks for co-manager for Christmas fund; Emeka confirms he will co-manage, being briefed this week.
[10] (about=Chisom, core, t2 @2025-10-26T15:19:00) Chisom agrees that Adaeze often says it's fine but it's not fully fine.
[11] (about=Emeka, core, t6 @2025-11-09T19:07:00) Emeka and Adaeze have privately discussed the fund process; Emeka will be briefed after Christmas.
[12] (about=Emeka, said_by=Adaeze, profile, t4 @2025-11-02T17:52:00) Adaeze says she will hold Emeka to his quarterly commitment and pins the message.
[13] (about=Emeka, core, t10 @2025-11-23T18:12:00) Emeka confirms he is already doing the co-management; Adaeze is briefing him on the spreadsheet this week.
[14] (about=Emeka, said_by=Chisom, profile, t4 @2025-11-02T17:52:00) Chisom references 'Sunday voice notes' between Emeka and Adaeze, implying a private communication pattern.
[15] (about=Ifeoma, core, t6 @2025-11-09T19:07:00) Ifeoma suggests setting up a standing order for the fund next year to avoid Adaeze chasing people.
[16] (about=Ifeoma, core, t2 @2025-10-26T15:19:00) Ifeoma supports Obiageli's point about Adaeze's workload and thinks it should be discussed properly.
[17] (about=Kingsley, said_by=Adaeze, profile, t8 @2025-11-16T16:22:00) Adaeze is genuinely shocked that Kingsley followed through on booking the venue.
[18] (about=Kingsley, core, t8 @2025-11-16T16:22:00) Kingsley booked the venue deposit on Wednesday and forwarded the confirmation to Adaeze.
[19] (about=Kingsley, said_by=Obiageli, profile, t0 @2025-10-19T11:04:00) Obiageli quotes their mother: 'a man who cannot keep small promises will not keep large ones', implying Kingsley should keep his promise.
[20] (about=Kingsley, core, t2 @2025-10-26T15:19:00) Kingsley proposes a pre-Christmas drinks gathering at his place in South London, open to family and close friends.
[21] (about=GROUP, said_by=Kingsley, group-interaction, t8 @2025-11-16T16:22:00) Kingsley has booked the venue for the summer party; confirmation forwarded to Adaeze.
[22] (about=GROUP, said_by=Nkechi, group-interaction, t6 @2025-11-09T19:07:00) Nkechi asks Kingsley to sort the Christmas fund half before Friday.
[23] (about=GROUP, said_by=Nkechi, group-interaction, t2 @2025-10-26T15:19:00) The fund responsibility distribution will be discussed properly in December.
[24] (about=Obiageli, core, t6 @2025-11-09T19:07:00) Obiageli insists someone else should learn the fund process from Adaeze now, not next year.
[25] (about=Obiageli, core, t14 @2025-12-07T17:36:00) Obiageli believes Christmas Day should be family only; Chisom is wise to wait.
[26] (about=Obiageli, core, t2 @2025-10-26T15:19:00) Obiageli believes Adaeze should not be the only one chasing contributions; suggests Nkechi or Emeka share responsibility.
[27] (about=Obiageli, core, t2 @2025-10-26T15:19:00) Obiageli distinguishes between family Christmas gathering and separate pre-Christmas events, emphasizing that Christmas Day is strictly family.
[28] (about=Obiageli, core, t14 @2025-12-07T17:36:00) Obiageli requests to join Christmas via video call, set up properly.
[29] (about=Obiageli, core, t1 @2025-10-26T15:12:00) Obiageli wants Christmas gathering protocol discussed early to avoid last-minute surprises.
agent_answer:
D. Ifeoma

Ifeoma is the one who both noted the recurring pattern — that Adaeze’s “fine for now” answer has been the same for a couple of years — and added that the issue should be discussed properly. Her message is distinguished from Obiageli’s similar point immediately before it because Ifeoma expressed hers as support for Obiageli’s point, explicitly adding that the matter should be put on the agenda / discussed properly, rather than simply stating the pattern the way Obiageli had.
